name: codex-wake-run
description: Run long-lived commands in a detached watcher and wake the originating Codex thread when they exit.

interface.shortDescription: Run long jobs and wake Codex on process exit
interface.longDescription: Launch long-running experiments in a detached background watcher, let the current Codex turn end immediately, and inject a fixed wake-up message into the originating thread when the process succeeds or fails.
defaultPrompt: Use wake-run to launch this experiment and continue after it exits.
